The DOC access that I am being provided with is a management guide. At no time will I share the information on this DOC with anyone other than management on a need-to-know basis. I will safeguard the information that it contains and immediately destroy aged reports upon completion. I understand that if I should breach the above agreement, I will not only lose my access to these reports but also face any legal repercussions that may arise as a result.

E-Temp Tag System Reminders

Lester Glenn Auto Group — Serving Ocean, Monmouth & Middlesex County — P.O. Box 908, Toms River, NJ 08754

Listed below is a brief summary of the most commonly asked questions that NJ CAR has been receiving. For more information, there is a detailed Q&A that can be found on NJ CAR's website (www.njcar.org).

The rules for issuance of Temporary Registrations have not changed. Only the process has changed.

Logs

Dealerships are not required to maintain manual logs for the issuance of E-Temp Tags. The E-Temp Tag System maintains the MVC-required log. However, a manual log of new car inspection decals must continue to be maintained. There has been no change to the requirements for retaining copies of Reassignment Forms.

Placement of the E-Temp Tag

All E-Temp Tags are to be affixed to the outside of the vehicle where the rear plate would normally be located. The exception is motorcycles, which must be carried by the driver.

Transferring Plates

When transferring plates, the plates must be removed from the vehicle (and stored in the trunk) with the E-Temp Tag placed on the rear of the vehicle. The exception is when handicapped plates are transferred — rear plate is removed and replaced with the E-Temp Tag. The front handicap plate would remain on the front of the vehicle.

Issuance of a Second Resident Temp

The rules for issuing a 2nd Resident E-Temp Tag are the same as the rules for issuing a 2nd Resident paper temp.

Voiding an E-Temp Tag

If an E-Temp Tag is issued for a specific VIN, and the deal is cancelled, the E-Temp Tag must be voided. If not, a subsequent E-Temp Tag for that specific VIN cannot be processed. Voided E-Temp Tags should be processed immediately and maintained by the dealership for a period of three years.

MVC-Authorized Signature Card

Any employee issuing E-Temp Tags must be listed on this MVC-required form.

Printer Jam / Reprinting the E-Temp Tag

If the printer jams and the dealership needs to reprint another E-Temp Tag, the dealership is required to retain the previously issued/damaged E-Temp Tag for three (3) years.

Reminder: If you void a temp because it does not print, make sure you provide Corporate with a screenshot of the void page.
